verdict.rationale: Rate limits are a fair question for a hosted API like Jina Reader, but no item in the evidence pack documents a requests-per-second or per-minute limit tied to an API key. A community user notes they could not find any mention of an API limit on the website, which shows the documentation gap rather than contradicting a claim.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in
